author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Also want to help move business clients to the #indieweb as the readers improve to show them how they can take ownership of social media presence without having to hand over their soul for analytics.

I have never gotten a client there. Takes me about 6 months just to get someone comfortable on their own.

Doing some local workshops for a couple small business friends on getting your business off of facebook, on your own site, then back into social media.
